name: Dan Tel Aviv
insider_take: This boutique gem sits in the heart of Tel Aviv's cultural quarter, where Bauhaus architecture meets Mediterranean cool.
whats_special: Dan Tel Aviv is perfectly positioned on bustling Hayarkon Street, just steps from the UNESCO-listed White City - home to the world's largest collection of Bauhaus buildings. The hotel's rooftop offers stunning views of the Mediterranean coastline, while its location puts you within walking distance of the vibrant Carmel Market and the trendy Florentin neighborhood's street art scene.
pro_tip: Book a sea-view room on higher floors for unobstructed Mediterranean vistas, especially during sunset when the entire coastline glows golden.
dont_miss: The nearby Rothschild Boulevard for its famous Bauhaus architecture walking tour, the eclectic Nachalat Binyamin Arts & Crafts Fair (Tuesdays and Fridays), and the ancient port city of Jaffa - just a 10-minute walk south along the promenade.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Tel Aviv's coastline
cons: Some rooms may show signs of age
